source.html:
A word to remember

"The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want." (Psalm 23:1)

Miriam said, Let us speak truth and show mercy. Read Matthew 5:7–9, then Matthew 5:7–9 again.

The cited work Morning Notes by Miriam has identifier BV-Q17.
source.title: Words to remember

translation.html:
'n Woord om te onthou

"Die HERE is my herder; ek sal nie gebrek ly nie." (Psalm 23:1)

Miriam het gesê, Laat ons die waarheid praat en barmhartigheid bewys. Lees Matteus 5:7–9, en dan weer Matteus 5:7–9.

Die aangehaalde werk Morning Notes deur Miriam het die identifiseerder BV-Q17.
translation.title: Woorde om te onthou
